messages.content: I’ll prioritize the high-priced morning reserves, charge at lower-priced hours, and leave room to manage regulation drift and any reserve deployments. I’ll check the full-day book before committing it, then monitor each watch through settlement.

The morning reserves earned without any failures to provide. RegUp deployed more than the mean forecast, leaving SoC at 124.41 MWh at noon. I’ll update the afternoon recharge and evening dispatch while keeping the fixed DA reserve awards.
